items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Heads To Civil Rights Trial After Record 580 Megawatt Battery Dispatch
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) faces a civil rights trial over racial harassment and discrimination claims tied to its Fremont Assembly plant. The case centers on allegations from Black workers who say they experienced racist slurs, graffiti and unequal treatment on the factory floor. Separately, Tesla and Sunrun coordinated what they describe as the largest residential distributed home battery dispatch event so far in California.
